book.name: 1 Tesalonica
book.title: To Una no Suyat ni Pablo diya to mgo Taga- Tesalonica

content: Kaling no wada noy on kaaguwanta to kamingaw iyu, migplanu koy no ogpabilin da diya to siyudad to Atenas.

Su ogpaandiyanon noy iyu si Timoteo no suun ta duon ki Jesu-Cristo. Katimbang sikandin to Diyus to pagwali to Madojow no Nawnangonon bahin ki Cristo. Pigpaandiyan noy sikandin to pagsambag iyu dow to pagdigon to pagtuu now
agun kona ogkaamonu to pagtuu now ko abuton kow to mgo kalisod. Namaan kow man no planu to Diyus no usahay meyduon igpamaantus ita,
su pigpatahanan noy on man sikiyu to sikan no diyan koy pad. Aw tinood iyan no pigtidow kow on to mgo antusonon.

Kaling nalimuut a su unu ko natintal kow on ni Satanas aw ogkauyakan to nangkaunagan noy diyan iyu. Kaling manno wada ad makaantus, pigsugu ku si Timoteo to pagyouy iyu agun mamaan a bahin iyu, yabi to pagtuu now.

Na kuntoon, angod to nahukasan koy to malig-ot no kabo su nakapauli on si Timoteo aw naisturyahan koy no wada kaisab to pagtuu dow paghigugma now. Mig-iling isab sikandin no madojow to ginhawa now kanami aw pigmingaw kow isab kanami angod to pagmingawa noy iyu.
Kaling mgo suun, nadasig koy tongod to pagtuu now. Ogsakiton koy iyan dow ogpakabaja to mgo kalisod kani,
di hayahay to paggiginhawa noy su namaanan noy no madigon kow on duon to Ginuu.
Ko hona-honaon noy to kalipay noy duon to atubangan to Diyus tongod iyu, kona ogkalituk to pagpasalamat noy kandin.
Aedow dow madukilom ogpak ampu koy no makayouy koy podom iyu, su basi da man madugangan noy ko meyduon pad nakuyang to pagtuu now.
Na, hinaut no gawangon to Diyus no Amoy ta dow ni Jesu-Cristo no Ginuu ta sikan ogpakabaebag to pagyouy noy iyu.
Hinaut isab no dugangan to Ginuu to paghinigugmaay now dow to gugma now to duma no mgo otow agun maangod sikan to paghigugma noy iyu.

Pinaagi to sikan, ogdigonon din to ginhawa now agun ogkaandam kow aw wada igkasawoy iyu duon to atubangan to Diyus no Amoy ta ko mupauli si Jesus no Ginuu ta no ogdumahan to tibo mgo sakup din no nangkamatoy on.
